cutting_wrist_mjcf — DRIVE cutting op

• Data kinds: table × scalar → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.cutting_wrist_mjcf(scene=None, theta_deg: 'float' = 4.0, k_n_per_mm: 'float' = 4.0, damping: 'float' = 25.0, mass: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'str' (to call the implementation directly, import cutting; cutting.cutting_wrist_mjcf(scene=None, theta_deg: 'float' = 4.0, k_n_per_mm: 'float' = 4.0, damping: 'float' = 25.0, mass: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'str'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("cutting_wrist_mjcf"))

Usage

Blade scene with a compliant wrist (MJCF string, mujoco not required). The blade has 1 vertical slide joint (spring k and damping); the food item and board are visual only.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

カメラ face は正射影で、画素の寸法と board_row が cutting_face_render と同じになるよう置く。画像の中心は画素中心で数えて ((H−1)/2, (W−1)/2)(H/2 と書くと 0.5 px ずれる)。関節の摩擦損失は硬くしてある(既定の柔らかい摩擦損失は速度に比例する粘性のように振る舞い、切断力が 1 桁小さく出る)。食材の抵抗は走行中に関節の摩擦損失として毎歩書き換える(cutting_mujoco_wrist)。
